#### Warmup, then cosine decay

A schedule for `torch.optim.SGD` at [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.1
uses [learning-rate warmup](#def-warmup) over 100 steps,
and then [cosine decay](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-cosine-decay) to 0 at step 1,000.
What learning rate does it give at step 550?
